title: Maintenance Person
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience in maintenance, repairs, or a similar role is considered an advantage
description_text:
Our client is seeking a reliable and hands-on Maintenance Person to join their team.
 About the Role
 The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out general maintenance, basic repairs, and routine inspections to ensure the company's facilities remain safe, functional, and well-maintained.
 This role is ideal for someone practical, proactive, and willing to work independently following an initial training and induction period.
 Key Responsibilities
 Carry out general maintenance tasks and minor repairs.
 Assist with basic electrical and plumbing works.
 Conduct routine inspections and identify maintenance requirements.
 Respond to maintenance requests and resolve issues promptly.
 Ensure facilities, equipment, and work areas are kept in good condition.
 Identify and report any issues requiring specialist attention.
 Follow health and safety procedures when carrying out maintenance work.
 Work collaboratively with the team to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the facilities.
 Requirements
 Valid driving licence. 
 Good spoken Maltese and English.
 Clean police conduct.
 Previous experience in maintenance, repairs, or a similar role is considered an advantage.
 Practical problem-solving skills and a hands-on approach.
 Reliable, organised, and committed to maintaining high standards.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
 What Our Client Offers
 Reduced working hours during the summer period.
 Sponsorship for professional qualifications and training.
 Health insurance.
 Staff discounts.
 Opportunities for professional development within a supportive working environment.
 Our client is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that values employee wellbeing, development, and equal opportunities.
 Ready to put your practical skills to work? Apply today and take the next step in your maintenance career!
